That changes right now.

In this video, you'll learn the 6 core concepts of microeconomics — clearly, one idea at a time, with no jargon and no skipped steps.

Here's what we cover:
→ Scarcity — why every choice is a resource allocation decision

Quantum Mechanics Explained Like You're 5

Electrons are particles that are also waves. You probably heard that in a classroom once and never actually understood why. This video builds quantum mechanics from the ground up — not vocabulary, real understanding — covering the core concepts that explain how atoms, computers, and modern technology actually work.

In this video you'll learn:
🔹 Quantization — why atoms only emit specific colors of light (and why neon signs glow the way they do)
🔹 Wave-particle duality — why electrons behave differently depending on how you observe them
🔹 The wave function — the real meaning behind this often-misunderstood term
🔹 Superposition — what it actually means for a particle to exist in multiple states at once
🔹 Wave function collapse (measurement) — why you never see quantum effects in daily life
🔹 The uncertainty principle — a fundamental limit of nature, not a flaw in our tools
🔹 Quantum tunneling — how electrons "impossibly" cross energy barriers

We also break down a real-world example — how solid state drives (SSDs) use quantization, tunneling, the uncertainty principle, and measurement together to store your data — plus the most common misconceptions people have about quantum physics and how to fix them.

By the end, you'll be able to explain why LED and neon lights produce fixed colors, why flash storage wears out over time, why chip manufacturers are hitting a physical wall as transistors shrink, and how to spot real quantum computing breakthroughs vs. hype.

Why most people get economics wrong (and how you can think better)

Most people think economics is about graphs, formulas, and things only experts understand. It’s not.

Economics is about one thing: how people make choices when they cannot have everything they want.

In this video, I break down the core ideas without jargon, without graphs, and without confusing theory. By the end, you’ll understand economics better than most adults.

You’ll learn:

Why every choice has a hidden cost (opportunity cost)

How incentives shape everything—from tax policy to your daily habits

What prices actually tell you (it’s not just a number)

Why price controls like rent control and minimum wage often backfire

The invisible side of every policy (what you don’t see matters more)

How profits and losses act as information signals

What really determines your paycheck—and how to earn more

Key takeaway:
Economics isn’t about being political. It’s about thinking clearly about choices, trade-offs, and unintended consequences. Once you see the world this way, it’s hard to get fooled again.
